name: Microphone Effects
author: caleb
description: The microphone half of Camera Effects as its own bar button: level meters, mute, and a reorderable channel strip (noise reduction, gate, compressor, de-esser, filters, parametric EQ, pitch and formant, voice effects, reverb) driving the same camera-effects-server daemon.

barWidget.description: Microphone channel strip with level meters; the icon shows muted or live at a glance and left-click opens the panel.

schema.label: Show icon even when no app is using the microphone
